thread.title: A new bug in Apple's operating systems can crash any Apple device with just one simple character (AAPL)

author: Edoardo Maggio
title: A new bug in Apple's operating systems can crash any Apple device with just one simple character (AAPL)
text: A new bug in Apple's operating systems can crash any Apple device with just one simple character (AAPL) By Edoardo Maggio Feb 15, 2018, 8:47 am 14 pts A character from an Indian dialect is at the heart of a new bug concerning all of Apple's operating systems. As soon as the character shows up, whether typed or received as part of a text, applications crash and can even freeze an iPhone's springboard entirely, possibly sending it in a bootloop.…
